notes.title: Girl travels through the Forest of Dreams - 2 'Ava' Demo Released!
notes.content:
Hello~ːsteamhappyː

Earlier this year, I announced that a sequel of this game was in development, right? It was scheduled for release this summer, but it took longer than expected.

Here is the demo version of the sequel!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3247090/___2__Demo/

The sequel deals with the story after this work. It supports Korean, Japanese, and English, with about 1 hour of content.

Since it is still a demo version, there are many shortcomings. We appreciate your feedback.

Have a great day!

notes.title: How the producer is doing
notes.content:
Hello~♥
I would like to thank everyone who enjoys this work, and I would like to share a brief update.

[hr][/hr]
[b]1. Recently, the RPGMaker community in Korea drew a game fan art, so I'm sharing it with you.[/b]
[list]
[*]"샤인" drew this. It's Yuri who shines her eyes while looking at the food Ragnar and Bonnie made.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/9a47a0755aa6c740128f474222448d1a77f0c090.png[/img]
[*]"바이러스" also drew Yuri, the main character. She's famous for creating a game called 'Period Survival'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/a69d132deae68e439789530ef418efe42b5b745c.png[/img]
[*]'루카' drew Lane, a Suin tribe, in the shape of a fox.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/5125bd83e087052ea96215971457de929a5b4ce1.jpg[/img]
[*]'나브' drw a picture of Yuri holding the final boss with a flame bomb. "Revolution is explosion!" she says.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/62f61ca0895edb8e687ff97ea3b94531a01b6b47.png[/img]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[b]2. We are planning to participate in the spring sale. [/b]
[list]
[*]Spring is the season when my family picked up the cat in the game, 'Bomi'
[*]Bomi has been our joy for a long time. But last summer, she crossed the rainbow bridge because of a mammary gland tumor.
[*]At that time, I thought I wanted to melt my memories with Bomi into the game. So I worked on it, and that's how this was born.
[*]So please shut up and look at the pictures of my cat, please!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/366118c0ccc786feec0031eb3bd28f71899f730b.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[b]3. 3. I participated in the "1 Chicken Alman Tool Game Jam 2024" competition with a piece called "태엽시계의 왕좌"[/b]
[list]
[*]This work is a collaboration by Team Eclipse, free of charge.We only support Korean.
[*]As of 2024.3.2, you can get it from the following Google Drive and try it.
[*][url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SK9Mti979ZF4JSiyNXGPZ4M36IBIyrpM/view?usp=sharing]https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SK9Mti979ZF4JSiyNXGPZ4M36IBIyrpM/view?usp=sharing[/url]
[*]From March 10, 2024, you can search for "태엽시계의 왕좌" on Stove Indy and enjoy it.
[*][url=https://store.onstove.com/ko]https://store.onstove.com/ko[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/9429c85a63b34b935072954c0931159eb7779bb4.png[/img]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[b]4. We started developing the next piece.[/b]
[*]The next piece will be the backstory that follows this game.
[*]It will be released around 2024.August.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/e7f5da6b296d047fd9dc8e4e50eaed7ec5b2933b.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for reading it. 

I would like to thank you again for your love and love of "Girl Travels Forest of Dreams." 

It's really, really late, but happy new year~♥

notes.title: Improved Japanese translation.
notes.content:
Hello, I'm a developer.

Through feedback from the Japanese community, hundreds of lines of the Japanese translation have been modified.

The part where the meaning is wrong, the part that doesn't fit the tone, the part that is difficult to understand in the context, and the part where Korean was still left.

Thank you for your help, and I hope you have a great journey!

notes.title: Japanese translation has been added!
notes.content:
As I announced a few days ago, a Japanese translation version has been added! 
I hope many people enjoy it in Japan, the home of RPG Maker.

Thank you Nursey for all your help. 


[*]In addition, some missing English translations have been modified.

[*] As I announced, my Japanese is not good, so it may be a little awkward. If you have any questions, please let us know at pidesa@msn.com and i will correct them.

[*] To continue with your existing save, copy the Save folder under the local file Girl_Travels_Forest_Of_Dream_EN,KR to under Girl_Travels_Forest_Of_Dream_JP.

notes.title: About the Japanese translation process!
notes.content:
Hi, I'm a developer.

It's been a week since I launched this game on Steam.

Some of the people who were interested in the game asked, "Do you have any thoughts of applying for Japanese?" Come to think of it, RPG Maker's hometown is Japan, and I think it would be good to support Japanese.

So I started translating into Japanese!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/ed005af118d3d79fffe5eda8c05ca7e64e12a431.png[/img]

However, I studied English for 6 years in school... Japanese is not like that. I've only watched Japanese animation for about 20 years. So I can listen a little bit, but I can't read and write at all. So I have no choice but to get help from a translator.

Still, I am working hard to review the translated sentences and look at the dictionary for words that may have a wrong meaning.
In 10 days, you will be able to enjoy this game in Japanese. (I don't know if you'll be satisfied.)

If I may ask for your understanding...

If you translate it into Japanese, the game capacity will increase by 50% now. This is because I didn't make the game thinking about translation from the beginning. I will try not to let this happen in the next work, so please forgive me this time. (Crying)

Then I will announce it again as soon as the Japanese translation is completed.

Enjoy your trip to the Forest of Dream! :)
